description:
This endpoint creates or updates a batch of Standard Cost Codes.
See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description:
The 'default' view only returns id and standard_cost_code_list_id. The 'compact' view also includes
origin_id. The 'extended' view includes the more complete list of attributes shown below. The 'ex...

id.description: Unique identifier for the Standard Cost Code. Use as the {id} path parameter in GET, PATCH, and DELETE /rest/v1.0/standard_cost_codes/{id}.

standard_cost_code_list_id.description: ID of the company-level standard cost code list this code belongs to. Use as the standard_cost_code_list_id query parameter when operating on this code. Always present.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent standard cost code in the hierarchy. Null for root-level codes. Only present in 'extended' view.

code.description: Cost code segment, not including the parent prefix. For example, for full code "02-300", this field is "300". Only present in 'extended' view.

full_code.description: Full cost code including all parent prefixes (e.g. "02-300"). Only present in 'extended' view.

name.description: Display name of the standard cost code. Only present in 'extended' view.

origin_data.description: Free-form third-party metadata string from the ERP system. Only present in 'extended' view.

origin_id.description: ERP system identifier for this standard cost code. Used by sync operations to match records across systems. Present in 'compact' and 'extended' views.

name.description: Display name of the standard cost code.

id.description: ID of an existing Standard Cost Code to update. When omitted or not found, the service attempts to match on origin_id and create or update accordingly.

code.description: Cost code segment, not including the parent prefix. For example, for full code "02-300", this field is "300".

parent_id.description: ID of the parent standard cost code. Creates a root-level code when omitted.

origin_id.description: ERP system identifier for this standard cost code. Used to match records across systems during sync.

origin_data.description: Free-form third-party metadata string from the ERP system.
